data.additional_information:
JOB Description – Business Development Associate
Business Development & Key Account Management
Leumas · Bengaluru
Leumas is seeking a Business Development Associate to manage and grow existing client accounts through disciplined account management, structured client engagement, and systematic revenue expansion.
This role is centred on owning the lifecycle of existing customer relationships, ensuring continuity of business, and driving incremental growth through cross-sell and upsell initiatives. The position requires a high degree of ownership, strong communication capability, and the ability to align client expectations with internal execution.

About Leumas
Leumas is a Bangalore-based deep-tech manufacturing company building a software-defined production platform for regulated healthcare manufacturing. Its integrated Manufacturing Operating System enables modular, scalable, and compliant production across nutraceuticals, pharmaceuticals, and wellness products.
Leumas partners with brands across early-stage, growth-stage, and enterprise segments, delivering agile, technology-driven manufacturing solutions.

The Role
As Business Development Associate, you will be responsible for the ongoing management, retention, and expansion of assigned client accounts.
You will serve as the primary interface for clients during active engagements, ensuring clarity in communication, alignment on deliverables, and continuity in execution. In parallel, you will identify and drive opportunities to expand the scope of engagement across products, formats, and services.
The role requires a structured and proactive approach to account growth, relationship management, and internal coordination.

What You Will Own
1. Account Ownership & Lifecycle Governance (Primary Responsibility)
• Assume end-to-end ownership of assigned client accounts across their engagement lifecycle.
• Ensure continuity, stability, and consistency in client interactions and ongoing business.
• Monitor account health, engagement status, and continuity of requirements.
• Act as the central point of coordination for all client-facing communication during active engagements.
2. Revenue Expansion & Account Growth
• Systematically identify and drive cross-sell and upsell opportunities within existing accounts.
• Expand account scope through additional SKUs, product formats, and service offerings.
• Strengthen account depth by increasing share of business across clients.
• Track, evaluate, and drive account-level growth initiatives.
3. Client Requirement Management & Alignment
• Develop a comprehensive understanding of client requirements, product pipelines, and business priorities.
• Ensure alignment between client expectations and internal execution capabilities.
• Translate client inputs into structured, actionable requirements for internal teams.
• Maintain clarity on scope, timelines, and deliverables across engagements.
4. Cross-Functional Coordination & Execution Oversight
• Work closely with NPD, operations, and supply chain teams to ensure seamless execution of client requirements.
• Track progress of ongoing workstreams and ensure timely communication of updates.
• Resolve coordination gaps and ensure alignment across functions.
5. Relationship Development & Retention
• Build and sustain long-term, trust-based client relationships.
• Ensure high levels of client satisfaction and engagement continuity.
• Proactively address concerns and manage expectations in a structured manner.
• Support the transition of clients from onboarding to stable, long-term partnerships.
